name: timewarp
description: Inspect Codex session timelines and generate transcript-only tool-call recovery prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect tool calls and plan safe transcript recovery.
interface.longDescription: Codex Timewarp parses local Codex JSONL session transcripts, shows a compact tool-call timeline, links calls to results, classifies recovery risk, and generates safe transcript-only recovery prompts without rewriting original sessions.
